name: application-comment-composer
title: Comment Composer
description: A rich comment input pairing a textarea with a mention/attach/emoji toolbar and a submit action, plus a compact single-line reply variant.
useWhen: Posting a top-level comment on an item (issue, post, document) where mentioning people, attaching a file, or adding an emoji are all in scope.
Replying to an existing comment in a compact thread, where a full toolbar is unnecessary but quick emoji access and a clear send action still are.
avoidWhen: You only need @-mention autocomplete without the surrounding toolbar and submit chrome — use the mention-textarea component directly instead.
The context is a simple form field rather than a social/collaborative comment thread — use a plain textarea or form-row instead.
responsiveBehavior: The full composer's toolbar row uses justify-between so the icon cluster and submit button stay pinned to opposite edges at any width; the reply variant is a single-row pill that already fits narrow contexts.
accessibility: The textarea/input carries a real (visually hidden) <label> rather than relying on the placeholder alone for its accessible name.
Each toolbar icon button has a descriptive aria-label (Mention someone, Attach a file, Add an emoji, Send reply) since none contain visible text.
The primary submit action is a real <button type="submit">, keyboard-operable and reachable independent of the toolbar icons.
